pr_title: chore: do not cache between reused context

issue_context.title: [BUG] do not cache main document between reusable context runs / vscode
issue_context.body:
As title says.

Repro steps:

1. npx http-server .
2. make a test.html file with some content
3. have a playwright test going to this file
4. make changes to test.html
5. run the playwright test again

expected: new test.html changes are surfaced
actual: old html.html changes are surfaced.

review_comments: Let's comment that all other caches are not persisted because ephemeral.
